as_told.title: At least nine craft held in US hangars

plain: Nine flying craft, he says, were parked in a row of hangars at S-4, a secret site in the Nevada desert where he says he worked in 1988 and 1989. Bob Lazar tells Michels this first-hand: looking down the line of hangars, he saw "other cars, nine of them all the way down there," which would mean the government kept a whole fleet, not just one. Pressed on the number, he says "nine for sure" and limits himself to "what I've seen."
